title: What's new promises gym pop-ups that iPhone members never get
what: The member app's What's new notes say messages and offers from the gym pop up on the phone right away, even when the app is closed, and even while it is open. The notes are shown on every phone. On iPhone every notification of the app is still off, so an iPhone member reads a promise that does not happen for them.
expected: Lines about pop-ups are shown only on phones that really get them, or say 'Android phones' in the words.
how_often: every iPhone member who reads these notes; cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check
fix_line: Leave Android-only lines out of What's new on iPhone, or name Android in them

title: iPhone members are never told a new version is ready
what: The update check stops at once on iPhone and shows nothing, until an App Store check is built. What's new tells every member that a pop-up says when a new version is ready. An iPhone member stays on an old version with fixes missing and nobody, member or HQ, sees that they were skipped.
expected: Either an App Store update check on iPhone, or the update promise is not shown there and HQ can see which iPhone versions are in use.
how_often: every new version, for every iPhone member
fix_line: Add the App Store version check for iPhone, or hide the update promise there

title: A team reply to a question older than 30 days brings no pop-up and no dot
what: The phone checks for team replies by itself only for questions asked in the last 30 days. If the MettleUp team answers a question later than that, the automatic check never asks for it, so no pop-up and no red dot come. Whether the help screen itself picks it up when opened depends on code outside this folder (unknown).
expected: A reply to any question still kept on the phone is noticed and shown.
how_often: only when the team replies after 30 days
fix_line: Ask for replies on every kept question, not only the last 30 days

title: The team-reply pop-up reaches only Android phones that already allow notifications
what: The 'MettleUp team answered your question' pop-up shows only on Android and only when notifications were already allowed; it never asks. The reply is then marked as told even though no pop-up was shown, so it is never retried. Only the red dot on the round button remains.
expected: Conditions are known: on a phone without permission or on iPhone the member still learns there is an answer (the red dot does this), and the reply is not marked as told when no pop-up was shown.
how_often: every reply on iPhone or on a phone with notifications off; cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check
fix_line: Mark a reply as told only after the pop-up was really shown

title: If the phone cannot count workouts, the 'only on this phone' warning silently never shows
what: The card that warns a member their workouts live only on this phone shows after 3 workouts. If counting the workouts fails, the count becomes 0 and the card never shows; the failure only goes to the phone's log, which nobody reads.
expected: A failed count is reported so the team learns of it, and the warning errs on the side of showing.
how_often: rare, only when the phone's database read fails
fix_line: Send a crash report on a failed count

title: Today asks the owner to send birthday and plan-ending messages without knowing the automatic reminders
what: Today shows '3 birthdays today - Send wishes' and '5 plans end this week - Remind them', and the 'Ending in 4-7 days' tile says 'Remind them this week'. These counts look only at the member list. The panel also has Automatic reminders the owner can switch on. Today never checks whether those already reach the same members, so an owner can send a second message by hand to people the system already messaged.
expected: When an automatic reminder covers a group, Today says so (for example 'sent automatically') or leaves those members out of the nudge.
how_often: every day an automatic reminder is on and the same group has people
fix_line: Let Today's nudges read the automatic reminder switches and leave out people already covered

title: The 'one by one' WhatsApp list forgets who was already sent a message
what: When the owner works through a list on WhatsApp one person at a time, the 'sent' ticks are kept only while that sheet is open. Closing it, refreshing, or a second staff member opening the same list starts from zero. Nothing records on the member that a fees or renewal message went out, so people can get the same message twice or be missed.
expected: Each 'sent' tap is saved on the member with the date and who sent it, and the list shows it next time.
how_often: every time the sheet is closed before the list is finished
fix_line: Save a 'message sent' note on the member when Send is tapped

title: The bell's number differs between the owner's phone and computer
what: Which gym alerts count as new in the bell is remembered only in the browser it was opened in. An owner who opens the bell on the computer still sees the same alerts counted as new on the phone, and two people sharing one desk computer clear each other's count.
expected: Opening the bell clears it for that person on every device, and only for that person.
how_often: every time the panel is used on more than one device or by more than one person
fix_line: Keep the bell's 'seen' time on the server per person

title: Needs you can say it is up to date when its lists failed to load
what: Every minute the panel reads the gym's alerts and then the lists (plan requests, check-in numbers, questions, member messages). If one of the lists fails, it is only written to the browser log; the old count stays and the panel still marks Needs you as freshly updated, because only an alerts failure counts as a failure.
expected: A list that failed to load makes the 'updated' mark say it could not refresh, so the owner knows the count may be old.
how_often: only when one list read fails while the alerts read works
fix_line: Count a failed list read as a failed refresh

title: On an Android phone the panel's in-page alert may never show
what: While the panel is open, a new item rings by making a browser notice directly. Chrome on Android does not allow notices made this way (only through the installed app's background worker), so on an owner's Android phone the notice fails and only goes to the browser log. The chime still plays, but nothing tells the owner what came in.
expected: The in-page notice uses the same background route as the push alerts, so it shows on phones too.
who: owners using the panel on an Android phone
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check
fix_line: Show the in-page notice through the service worker

title: The owner cannot see which devices or staff get the gym's alerts
what: Alerts are switched on per device. The Settings card shows only whether this device is on. The owner has no list of which phones or computers (or which staff) will get an alert, so a switch-on on one device can leave everyone else silently without alerts.
expected: Settings lists every device and person with alerts on, and who has them off.
how_often: every gym with more than one device or staff member
fix_line: Show a list of devices with alerts on in the alerts card

title: The alerts settings vanish without a word when the gym server is older or the read fails
what: The alerts card and the bell's 'Turn on alerts' are hidden until the gym's server has the alerts update; if reading the settings fails, the card also stays hidden and the error goes only to the browser log. The owner sees no alerts option and no reason.
expected: The card says alerts are not ready yet, or could not be read, instead of disappearing.
how_often: gyms whose server lacks the alerts update, or when the read fails
fix_line: Show a short 'not ready' or 'could not load' line in place of the card

title: A member who paid online can show as 'pay at the desk' when the payment read fails
what: On the 'joined online' card, if reading the join-page payments fails (no internet, an older server), the rows fall back to 'pay at the desk' as if no payment existed; the failure goes only to the browser log. The desk can ask a member who already paid online to pay again.
expected: When payments could not be read, the row says the online payment could not be checked and Approve waits.
who: owners, desk staff and members who paid online
how_often: only when the payment read fails
fix_line: Show 'could not check the online payment' instead of 'pay at the desk'

title: Approve skips the refund check silently when the payment company does not answer
what: Before Approve records an online payment as paid, the panel asks the payment company again whether it was refunded. If that check gets no answer, Approve goes on anyway and the owner is not told the check was skipped, so a refunded payment can be saved as paid.
expected: The owner is told the refund check could not be done and can choose to wait.
how_often: only when the check gets no answer and the payment was refunded
fix_line: Ask the owner before approving when the refund check did not answer

title: The server can miss that a receipt was made for an online join
what: After Approve saves the member, plan and receipt, the panel tells the server the receipt is made. If that last call fails, it only goes to the browser log. The server's record of the online payment then still says no receipt, and nobody is told.
expected: A failed 'receipt made' note is retried, or the owner is told to tap again.
how_often: only when that last call fails
fix_line: Retry the 'receipt made' note later and show it if it keeps failing

title: 'Birthdays today' reads 0 without saying how many members have no birthday saved
what: The Today tile and the 'Send wishes' nudge count only members with a birthday saved. Birthday is optional on import, so a gym with few birthdays saved sees 0 and no hint why. The real share on Crispy Curves was not counted (no database query allowed in this step).
expected: The tile says how many members have no birthday saved and links to add them.
how_often: unknown, depends on how many birthdays a gym saved
fix_line: Add a 'N members have no birthday' line under the tile
